notes: Background: Mid-market B2B productivity SaaS. Shipping contextual help + AI-driven in-app assistance across web and mobile.
Engagement summary: Started on Hosted API (Aug 2024) to validate latency & quality. Moved to paid POC (Oct) to test Dedicated economics and autoscaling behavior.

POC results (11/07 review): Gen-quality OK on Llama-2 variant; 95th pct latency target met in hosted tests (~280ms p95 for 512-token responses). Dedicated POC demonstrated stable throughput at 45-60 RPS with autoscale bursts to 90 RPS for short windows.

Primary asks discovered: predictable monthly unit cost, burst allowance for product launches, ability to pin model versions and a rollback policy, VPC peering + KMS integration, and SSO/SAML + audit logs for compliance.

Pricing conversation: Customer prefers a committed capacity + burst pool model. Proposal under review from Redwood: 3-tier commit options (baseline, mid, high) with 25% monthly burst credit and overage at 1.5x committed rate. Customer counter: wants lower overage (1.2x) and explicit 3-month ramp schedule tied to feature release calendar.

Finance note: CFO wants ARR predictability. Suggested structure: 12-month commitment with quarterly ramp (30% -> 60% -> 100%) and an option to increase commit at renewal. Finance requesting cap on aggregate overage charges per quarter.

Legal: Submitted redlines to Dedicated MSA (limitation of liability, data residency clause). Need Redwood legal to accept small edits to KMS language and SLA credits. Target to close before 2024-12 end of year procurement window.

Security: Running KMS integration test in staging (ticket SEC-4219). Requesting SOC 2 Type II report and penetration test summary; already received SOC2 but wants confirmation of audit_logging retention settings.

Quotes from stakeholders: Head of Product: "We need predictable costs for the next 12 months — bursts for launches are non-negotiable." Engineering Director: "If Dedicated can meet latency & KV cache behavior from POC we can consolidate requests to one provider."
Risks: If pricing flexibility not acceptable, customer will explore hybrid (Hosted + second provider for bursts) or evaluate alternative Dedicated vendors (Anthropic offerings).
Next steps (short): 1) Pricing call with Marcus + Anika + customer finance on 2024-11-27. 2) Legal redlines follow-up by 2024-11-22. 3) Security KMS staging test completion ETA 2024-11-25.

Action items assigned: Marcus to send revised pricing scenarios (ramp + cap on overage) by 2024-11-23; Anika to prepare performance numbers from POC; David to draft onboarding/checklist for post-sign rollout.
